description: An explorer's follow of an actor, written into the explorer's OWN repo (never the sponsor's). Mirrors app.bsky.graph.follow — a subject DID plus createdAt — so a follow → mainline conversion tool is possible later (a spec note, not built). Device-local follows exist in every mode (they power My Sky); this persisted record only exists when the explorer has an account (localOnly off). The explorer can delete her own follows; the sponsor cannot.
